thread:
jen: Heads-up on PR #512  it's a migration + wording tidy for the SDK v2 snippets on the audit and retention pages. Legal flagged a few ambiguous lines around TTL and export scope.

rachel: linking the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 

miguel: skimmed it. main UX problem: examples mix tenant-scoped calls with global admin examples without calling that out. We should label them clearly.

legal-ops: request: please add a single clarifying sentence wherever TTL appears: 'TTL applies to the specific tenant's collected audit entries unless the example explicitly uses an organization/global API.' Also, replace 'permanent' with 'indefinite retention (subject to legal hold)'.

jen: agreed. proposed structure: 1) show tenant-scoped SDK snippet (JS + Py) marked "tenant-scoped"; 2) show global/admin snippet and label it; 3) short CLI export showing redact flags; 4) one-line SOC2-safe wording. Keep it terse.

miguel: I'll rework the snippets. Suggested JS tenant example:

```js
// tenant-scoped: set 90-day retention for tenant "acme"
await client.audit.setRetention({ tenantId: 'acme', ttlSeconds: 90 * 24 * 3600 });
// human note: 90 days
```

and a global/admin example:

```py
# global/admin: set default retention for the organization
client.admin.set_default_retention(ttl_seconds=180*24*3600)
# This affects logs that opt into org-wide policies.
```

rachel: nice. add a short parenthetical after the tenant snippet: '(Tenant-scoped retention controls only that tenant's collected logs.)' and after the admin snippet: '(Global settings do not override explicit tenant configs unless the tenant is opted-in.)'

legal-ops: also include the SOC2 phrasing for the compliance landing page: 'Retention and redaction settings are configurable per-tenant. Redwood applies default redaction rules and supports customer-managed encryption for private deployments.' Keep to one sentence.

jen: include a CLI export example showing redaction, e.g.:

```bash
# export and redact IP and email fields
redwood audits export --tenant acme --since 2026-03-01 --redact ip,email
```

miguel: will add SDK-level redact param examples too (JS: redact: ['ip','email'], Py: redact=['ip','email']). Also will ensure code comments use human-friendly durations.

rachel: quick QA: update the docs internal link anchors that point to the audit schema; CI linkcheck has historically caught a few broken anchors. If you add new headings, add the anchor-friendly id.

docs-bot: PR #512 updated by miguel  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ghi789 :rocket: 

legal-ops: LGTM pending CI. One tiny ask: where we mention legal hold, use 'indefinite retention (subject to legal hold)' not 'legal hold may apply'.

jen: great. miguel, rachel  action items: miguel update snippets and add one-line clarifications; rachel run linkcheck and verify anchors; legal-ops will sign-off after CI. I'll merge post-approval.

miguel: changes pushed. PR now contains: labeled tenant vs admin examples, CLI and SDK redact samples, and the one-line SOC2-safe sentence.

rachel: CI green on my linkcheck run locally; waiting for remote CI.

docs-bot: CI passed on branch  ready to merge.

legal-ops: Approved. Thanks for keeping the copy concise.

jen: merging now. Closing thread. :tada:
